nodes.name: RoadmapEditorController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing roadmap editor endpoints for fetching a career's editable node graph, saving node layout positions, and creating, updating, and deleting roadmap nodes.

nodes.name: RoadmapEditorController
nodes.summary: Controller class delegating roadmap editor HTTP requests (get, save positions, create, update, delete node) to RoadmapEditorService.

nodes.name: getCareerNodes
nodes.summary: Handles the endpoint returning all editable roadmap nodes for a given career.

nodes.name: saveNodePositions
nodes.summary: Handles the endpoint that persists bulk node layout position updates from the roadmap editor UI.

nodes.name: createNode
nodes.summary: Handles the endpoint that creates a new roadmap node under a given career.

nodes.name: updateNode
nodes.summary: Handles the endpoint that updates an existing roadmap node's fields.

nodes.name: deleteNode
nodes.summary: Handles the endpoint that deletes a roadmap node after validating it has no dependent progress or children.

nodes.name: SaveNodePositionsRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying a batch of node position updates submitted from the roadmap editor's drag-and-drop layout UI.

nodes.name: UpsertRoadmapNodeRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO for creating or updating a roadmap node, capturing name, description, stage, completion policy, weight, hierarchy references, resources, and layout fields.

nodes.name: RoadmapNodeResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO representing a roadmap node's full editor and student-facing state, including hierarchy, stage, layout, progress, and FPT resource coverage fields.

nodes.name: NodeType.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity defining a roadmap node's type metadata: stage classification, unlock key requirements, and weight used in progress scoring.

nodes.name: RoadmapNodeLayout.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity persisting a roadmap node's visual editor layout: canvas position, lane, display order, layout version, and last editor.

nodes.name: onUpdate
nodes.summary: JPA lifecycle callback that stamps updatedAt with the current time before an update.

nodes.name: StageType.java
nodes.summary: Enum representing roadmap learning stages (e.g., foundation, intermediate) with helpers to parse from and format to frontend-friendly string values.

nodes.name: fromString
nodes.summary: Parses a string value into the matching StageType enum constant, case-insensitively.

nodes.name: toFrontendValue
nodes.summary: Converts a StageType enum constant into its frontend-facing display string.

nodes.name: NodeTypeRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository providing CRUD access to NodeType entities.

nodes.name: RoadmapNodeLayoutRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data JPA repository for RoadmapNodeLayout, adding lookups by single node ID and by a collection of node IDs.

nodes.name: RoadmapEditorService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining the roadmap editor contract: fetching career nodes, saving layout positions, and creating, updating, and deleting nodes.

nodes.name: RoadmapEditorServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements roadmap editor business logic: builds editable node DTOs, validates and applies node field/reference updates (including ancestor-cycle prevention), manages layout persistence, and enforces deletion safety checks against student progress and child nodes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a private helper-method pipeline (applyLogic, applyNodeType, resolveReference, assertNoAncestorCycle, applyLayout) to compose validation and persistence steps for node upserts, including cycle detection when reassigning parent/previous node references.

nodes.name: RoadmapEditorServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Service implementation coordinating skill node, node type, layout, career role, and student progress repositories to power the roadmap editor's CRUD and validation logic.

nodes.name: getCareerNodes
nodes.summary: Loads all skill nodes for a career along with their layouts and maps them to editor DTOs.

nodes.name: saveNodePositions
nodes.summary: Applies a batch of layout position updates, performing optimistic-concurrency version checks and bumping layout versions on save.

nodes.name: createNode
nodes.summary: Creates a new skill node for a career, applying request field logic and initial layout.

nodes.name: updateNode
nodes.summary: Updates an existing skill node's fields and layout based on the upsert request.

nodes.name: deleteNode
nodes.summary: Deletes a skill node after verifying no student progress exists against it and it has no dependent child nodes.

nodes.name: applyLogic
nodes.summary: Applies request fields (name, description, completion policy, proficiency, parent/previous references, resources, type) onto a skill node entity.

nodes.name: applyNodeType
nodes.summary: Creates or updates the NodeType associated with a node, setting stage and weight from the request.

nodes.name: resolveReference
nodes.summary: Resolves a referenced node ID (parent or previous node) into an entity, validating it belongs to the same career and isn't self-referential, then checks for ancestor cycles.

nodes.name: assertNoAncestorCycle
nodes.summary: Walks up a candidate node's parent/previous chain to detect and reject cycles before allowing a reference assignment.

nodes.name: applyLayout
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a node's layout row with position, lane, and display order from the request, bumping the layout version and editor.

nodes.name: loadLayouts
nodes.summary: Bulk-loads layout rows for a set of node IDs into a map keyed by node ID.

nodes.name: parseStage
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a stage string into a StageType enum, throwing a client error on invalid input.

nodes.name: parseCompletionPolicy
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes a completion policy string against the set of allowed values.

nodes.name: toResourceJson
nodes.summary: Converts a list of resource link strings into a JSON array node, filtering out blank entries.

nodes.name: toEditorDto
nodes.summary: Maps a skill node entity and its layout into a RoadmapNodeResponse DTO for the editor UI.

nodes.name: requireCareer
nodes.summary: Looks up a career role by ID or throws a not-found exception.

nodes.name: requireNode
nodes.summary: Looks up a skill node by ID or throws a not-found exception.

nodes.name: currentUserId
nodes.summary: Resolves the currently authenticated user's ID from the security context and user repository.
